preconditions.description: The input contains at least two lines: the first with n and the second with n integers.
The number of integers n is between 1 and 32768 inclusive, where lines is the list of input lines.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= x < 32768 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains exactly n integers, each between 0 and 32767 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, one for each input integer.

postconditions.expression: all(results[i] == min_ops(a[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the minimum number of operations required to transform the corresponding input integer to 0 using the allowed operations.
The output is formatted as n space-separated integers on a single line.
